readings: Group signals by `rfistat`, treating NULL as its own group. For each group, average non-NULL `modindex` values. Use the average non-NULL `modindex` across all signals, with each signal counted once, as the baseline. Keep groups whose average exceeds the baseline. For each kept group, show its RFI status, its unrounded average modulation index, its unrounded average minus the baseline, and the unrounded absolute difference between its average and the unweighted mean of the kept groups’ averages.

Group signals by `rfistat`, treating NULL as its own group. For each group, average non-NULL `modindex` values. Use the average non-NULL `modindex` across all signals, with each signal counted once, as the baseline. Keep groups whose average exceeds the baseline. For each kept group, show its RFI status, its unrounded average modulation index, its unrounded average minus the baseline, and its unrounded average minus the unweighted mean of the kept groups’ averages.
queries:
WITH baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
),
rfi_groups AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
kept AS (
    SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_modindex, b.avg_modindex AS baseline_avg
    FROM rfi_groups AS g
    CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
    WHERE g.avg_modindex > b.avg_modindex
)
SELECT
    rfistat,
    avg_modindex,
    avg_modindex - baseline_avg AS above_baseline,
    ABS(avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM kept)) AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept

WITH baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS baseline_avg
    FROM signals
),
group_averages AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
kept_groups AS (
    SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_modindex
    FROM group_averages AS g
    CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
    WHERE g.avg_modindex > b.baseline_avg
)
SELECT
    k.rfistat,
    k.avg_modindex,
    k.avg_modindex - b.baseline_avg AS difference_from_baseline,
    k.avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM kept_groups) AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept_groups AS k
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
